corrected_text: ML Drift's metal::InferenceContext::InitFromGpuModel encodes the GpuModel FlatBuffer if serialization is requested, then runs CopyFromGpuModel, MemoryManager::AllocateMemory, (ours) registers its RebindPoolTensors callback with the memory manager (SetRebind), then GetMutableNodes, CompileOperations, BindTensorsToOperations, UpdateParams, Tune(TuningType::kFast), resets external mutable tensors to null, finishes serialization, skips the (disabled) ICB block, and (ours) calls DumpGraphForTelemetry('built').

corrected_text: ML Drift's metal::MemoryManager in our tree takes, for each buffer it needs, the smallest buffer it already owns that fits, unless that one is more than twice the size and over 16 MB larger (ours: 1f6e7f85), and allocates a new MTLBuffer when none fits; every prefill graph (64 or more positions per run) gets a pool of its own that other graphs don't borrow from (ours: d3730b60, d0b392a2), and a prefill graph's own buffers (when they total 256 MB or more) are freed when another graph runs next and allocated again before the prefill runs again (ours: b96dedea, through GpuInferenceContextMetal::BeforeInvoke); the other graphs' buffers stay until the manager is destroyed. LiteRT's GpuBackendMetalLitert passes its shared manager to CreateInferenceContext when may_share_memory_manager is set and always to RestoreInferenceContext.
note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: meaning changed. memory_manager.mm at b7b856a0 (same in the shipped 6da75396): TakeAvailableBuffer 105-126 refuses a buffer > 2x size and > 16 MB over (1f6e7f85); AllocateMemory 162-188 marks graphs with >= 64 positions per run as private_models_ (d3730b60, then d0b392a2 for every prefill); AvailableBuffers 461-466 gives private models nothing and hides private buffers from others; BeginRun/ReleasePending/EnsureBuffers 245-347 free a prefill graph's own buffers (>= kMinReleaseBytes 256 MB) when another graph runs and recreate them before its next run (b96dedea), called from GpuInferenceContextMetal::BeforeInvoke (gpu_backend_metal.mm 587-612). gpu_backend_metal_litert.mm 136-157 unchanged.

corrected_text: In our ML Drift, InferenceContext::EncodeTimed (telemetry level 4) encodes each kernel in its own compute encoder with stage-boundary timestamp sampling when supported, and a completion handler records each kernel's GPU time in a span named 'gpu.k.<run>:<kernel>' (run: prefill, decode, verify, drafter or other; kernel: the node name with any ' -> ...' tail replaced by ' +fused'), followed by the output and input shapes when AGELLO_KERNEL_SHAPES=1 (ours: a5db0fc4).
